_comment: Seed pool for the bit library. Mike-curated. Add entries as you find them —
no need to fill every field, the importer will backfill what it can.
kind:           'short'   = Shorts / clips, eligible for bit of the day
'special' = full sets, shelf only, never the daily bit
title:          how YOU refer to it, not the uploader's SEO title
official_where: legit streaming home if one exists (Netflix, Prime, his site).
Matters most for specials — unofficial uploads rot.
note:           optional. why it's in here. shows up in the admin view.
